# Thomas Cherickal — The Digital Futurist (2020–present)

> Technical Content Engineer and Developer Educator for Generative AI and Quantum companies.
> 500+ published technical articles across 10+ platforms since 2020.
> Based in Chennai, India. All work remote and asynchronous, Generative AI-accelerated
> and hand-verified in Python, Golang, and Rust.

## What I do
- Developer documentation: API references, SDK guides, quickstarts, migration guides
- Technical deep dives across Generative AI Systems and Quantum Systems
- Quantum developer content: IBM Qiskit, PennyLane, quantum machine learning, quantum algorithms, post-quantum cryptography
- Developer education: courses, tutorial series, structured learning paths
- Generative AI-accelerated research and drafting, disclosed and available standalone
- Verified code and circuit benchmarking: execution-checked, not eyeballed
- Content architecture for humans and AI agents
- Launch and migration content for Generative AI and quantum products
- Remote Generative AI and quantum-readiness training for engineering teams
- Books and digital products, including RECRUITED
